## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: merge-to-main.sh is a thin dispatcher that execs merge-to-main-direct.sh when merge.strategy=direct and stubs merge-to-main-pr.sh with a clear "not yet implemented" error when merge.strategy=pr
- DD3: merge-to-main-direct.sh contains the extracted current behavior with no functional change; all existing merge-to-main tests pass
- DD5: CLAUDE.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, sprint/SKILL.md, end-session/SKILL.md, and the .claude/scripts/dso shim are audited and continue to work correctly with the dispatcher pattern
- DD6: merge-to-main.sh --resume is well-defined: PR-mode runs use a distinct state schema prefix; a direct-mode state file passed to a PR-mode --resume run is rejected with a clear error
- DD7: dispatcher exits 1 with clear error on unknown merge.strategy values
- DD9: unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## TDD Requirement
Pre-existing RED tests (written by ae31-ba7d, story-level dependency):
- test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script → FAIL before this task (dispatcher not implemented)
- test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script → FAIL before this task (merge-to-main-pr.sh does not exist)
- test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy → FAIL before this task (cross-strategy check not implemented)
All in: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh

Test approach for dispatcher routing:
- Given: tmpdir with dso-config.conf having merge.strategy=direct; stub merge-to-main-direct.sh in PATH that writes a sentinel file
- When: bash merge-to-main.sh is run with PROJECT_ROOT=$tmpdir CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$DSO_PLUGIN_DIR
- Then: sentinel file exists (direct.sh was exec'd)

After this task, tests 1, 2, 5, 6 in test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh pass (GREEN); tests 3, 4 have RED markers in .test-index (S7 scope, remain failing).

Gate 3 bundling justification: splitting dispatcher routing (tests 1,2) from --resume cross-strategy check (test 5) would require a temporary RED marker for test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy in the intermediate commit, creating a misleading state in .test-index (a test that should become GREEN in this story appearing as permanently deferred). The merge_strategy state schema change is inseparably coupled to the --resume cross-strategy check.

## Implementation Steps

### 1. Update .test-index (do this first, in the same commit)
- Add to merge-to-main.sh entry (or create new entries):
  - `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_direct] [test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent]`
  - `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_direct] [test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent]`
  - Add standalone RED markers as new lines:
    - `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_direct]`
    - `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent]`

### 2. Create plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh
- Extract the ENTIRE body of current merge-to-main.sh (all phases, --resume, --bump logic) verbatim
- The script takes the same flags (--bump, --resume, --help) as the current merge-to-main.sh
- Must be chmod +x
- Zero functional change from current merge-to-main.sh behavior

### 3. Create plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (stub)
- Minimal stub that prints "ERROR: PR merge mode not yet implemented (merge-to-main-pr.sh)" to stderr and exits 1
- Must be chmod +x

### 4. Modify plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh (thin dispatcher)
Keep only:
- Shebang, set -euo pipefail
- --help flag handling (early exit, same content as current --help)
- REPO_ROOT resolution (PROJECT_ROOT or git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
- CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT validation
- read merge.strategy from dso-config.conf via read-config.sh (or direct grep of $REPO_ROOT/.claude/dso-config.conf as fallback)
  - Default: direct (when key absent)
  - Unknown value: print "ERROR: Unknown merge.strategy '<value>'. Valid values: direct, pr" to stderr, exit 1
- --resume cross-strategy check (see below)
- exec merge-to-main-direct.sh or merge-to-main-pr.sh (forwarding all args with "$@")
  - Use: PATH="${_SCRIPT_DIR}:$PATH" exec merge-to-main-direct.sh "$@" (so CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT resolution still works)
  - Or: exec "${_SCRIPT_DIR}/merge-to-main-direct.sh" "$@"

### 5. --resume cross-strategy check in merge-to-main.sh
Before exec'ing the strategy script, when --resume flag is present:
- Find state file: /tmp/merge-to-main-state-${BRANCH_SAFE}.json
  - BRANCH_SAFE requires knowing the branch. But we don't know the branch before exec'ing. Solution: look for ANY /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*.json file (most recent) and read its 'merge_strategy' field.
  - Alternative (simpler): scan for state files matching the pattern, pick the most recent
  - If found and has merge_strategy field: compare to current config merge.strategy
  - If mismatch: print "ERROR: --resume cross-strategy mismatch: state file was written with merge.strategy='<stored>', but current config has merge.strategy='<current>'" to stderr, exit 1
  - If state file not found or merge_strategy absent: proceed (fail open - backward compat for old state files)

### 6. Modify plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh (_state_init)
- In the python3 block that writes the fresh state JSON, add 'merge_strategy': '<value>' field
- The MERGE_STRATEGY value must be passed in from merge-to-main-direct.sh or read from config
  - Simplest: add an env var MERGE_STRATEGY that merge-to-main.sh exports before exec'ing the strategy script
  - _state_init reads MERGE_STRATEGY from env, defaults to "direct" if absent (backward compat)

### 7. Consumer audit
- Read CLAUDE.md: verify merge-to-main.sh references are to the command interface (flags, not internals) - no changes expected
- Read plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md: phase list (sync → merge → ...) remains accurate (phases are in merge-to-main-direct.sh) - may need a note that merge-to-main.sh is now a dispatcher
- Read plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md: uses .claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh with --bump and --resume - no changes needed
- Read plugins/dso/skills/end-session/SKILL.md: same - no changes needed
- Read .claude/scripts/dso: just proxies to the plugin script - no changes needed
- Document findings as a comment on this task or in the commit message

## Backward Compatibility
- Old state files (written before this story, no merge_strategy field): --resume cross-strategy check must fail-open (treat absent field as "no stored strategy", proceed without rejection)
- _state_init's MERGE_STRATEGY default: if MERGE_STRATEGY env var is absent (e.g., merge-to-main-direct.sh called directly without dispatcher), default to "direct"

## Files to Modify/Create
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh
- MODIFY: .test-index (add new entries + RED markers)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] merge-to-main-direct.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh
- [ ] merge-to-main-pr.sh exists, is executable, exits 1 with error output
  Verify: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=plugins/dso bash plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -qi "not yet implemented" && echo "PASS"
- [ ] Dispatcher test 1 passes: merge.strategy=direct routes to merge-to-main-direct.sh
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script.*PASS"
- [ ] Dispatcher test 2 passes: merge.strategy=pr routes to merge-to-main-pr.sh
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script_pr_invoked.*PASS"
- [ ] Dispatcher test 5 passes: --resume rejects cross-strategy mismatch
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy_exits_nonzero.*PASS"
- [ ] Dispatcher test 6 passes: direct mode regression no-network
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test_direct_mode_regression_no_network.*PASS"
- [ ] Unknown merge.strategy value causes exit 1 with clear error message
  Verify: _T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/test-dispatcher.XXXXXX) && printf 'merge.strategy=unknown_value\n' > "$_T/.claude/dso-config.conf" && PROJECT_ROOT="$_T" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=plugins/dso bash plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh 2>&1 | grep -qi "unknown" && rm -rf "$_T"
- [ ] merge-helpers.sh _state_init writes merge_strategy field to state JSON
  Verify: grep -q 'merge_strategy' plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh
- [ ] Old state files (no merge_strategy) handled gracefully in --resume (fail-open)
  Verify: confirmed by test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy test structure (state file with merge_strategy; absence = no rejection)
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for CONFLICT_DATA tests (S7 scope)
  Verify: grep -q 'test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh \[test_conflict_data_schema_direct\]' .test-index
- [ ] All existing test-merge-to-main*.sh tests continue passing
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -v "test_conflict_data_schema" | grep -v FAIL

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Transform merge-to-main.sh into dispatcher; extract merge-to-main-direct.sh; create merge-to-main-pr.sh stub; add merge_strategy to state schema; implement cross-strategy --resume rejection; update .test-index
